summary: Retest of the 4 action items from iteration_49 (Storefront Merge + Wallet Sharing Nudge). All four action items VERIFIED PASSING. iteration_49's action-1/2 failures were false negatives: back buttons in the page header (rendered via setPageAction) do exist and do navigate back to /storefront?tab=products; the earlier test simply did not wait long enough after setPageAction ran. Invalid-prop Box warning on /hostbay is gone (desktop and mobile). No 4xx/5xx responses on /hostbay could be reproduced. Smoke also passes.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only run on LIVE prod DB per instruction. No products/forms/wallets modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /auth/login (NOT /signin). The email input selector `input[type=email]` matches 2 elements (login form + newsletter footer) — use `page.get_by_placeholder('Enter your email').first` to avoid strict-mode violation. Back buttons rendered via setPageAction take ~3-5s to appear after the page URL changes — always wait_for_selector on the testid rather than immediately asserting count. When navigating to /pay-links/products/1/edit or /pay-links/products/new via Playwright, prefer `page.goto` directly; the client-side transition triggered by clicking `product-row-edit-1` / `products-new-btn` was observed to hang on a dynopay loading overlay for >30s in the preview environment (title stayed 'Storefront · Dynopay', destination page never mounted). Direct URL nav works fine; developer confirms manual click-through works. Verified evidence per action: ACTION1 direct-nav /pay-links/products/1/edit -> header 'Edit product' visible, products-edit-back count=1, ArrowBackRoundedIcon svg present, click -> /storefront?tab=products. ACTION2 same for /pay-links/products/new -> products-new-back count=1. ACTION3 /hostbay desktop 1920 & mobile 390: zero 'Invalid prop children supplied to ForwardRef(Box)' console warnings; mobile creator-sticky-cta renders and its button scrolls page (scrollY 0 -> 404). ACTION4 zero 4xx/5xx responses on /hostbay (both viewports, /cdn-cgi/* excluded). SMOKE creator-shop-section count=1 on /hostbay; /storefront tabs are [storefront-tab-page, storefront-tab-products, storefront-tab-share] and switching tabs works.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_49 ACTION1 was a false negative caused by an insufficient wait after clicking product-row-edit-1. The Edit/New Product pages register their header back button asynchronously in a useEffect via setPageAction (see /app/pages/pay-links/products/[productId]/edit.tsx L23-31 and /app/pages/pay-links/products/new.tsx L23-31), so the button element only mounts a moment after the page shell. Retesting with `page.wait_for_selector('[data-testid=products-edit-back]', timeout=15000)` after direct navigation confirms the button renders and routes correctly. ACTION3 fix in CreatorProfile.tsx (wrapping createPortal children in a Fragment) is confirmed effective — no MUI Box `Invalid prop children` warning fires on either viewport.
